title: Returning a faulty phone
context: You bought a phone two weeks ago and the screen is faulty. You are in the shop.

a.speaker: Assistant
a.say: Good afternoon. How can I help?

choices.text: Hello. I bought this phone two weeks ago and the screen has stopped working. I'd like a refund, please.
choices.textSo: Salaan. Telefoonkan waxaan iibsaday laba toddobaad ka hor, shaashaddiisuna way istaagtay. Waxaan jeclaan lahaa in lacagta la ii celiyo, fadlan.
choices.feedbackSo: Dhibaatada iyo codsiga si cad ayuu u sheegay.

choices.text: This phone is rubbish!
choices.feedback: Complaining without details makes it harder to get help.
choices.textSo: Telefoonkan waa wax aan qiimo lahayn!
choices.feedbackSo: Cabasho aan faahfaahin lahayn waxay adkaynaysaa in lagu caawiyo.

choices.text: I think there's a problem with this phone. Could you take a look?
choices.feedback: Polite, but state what you want.
choices.textSo: Waxaan u malaynayaa in telefoonkan cilad ka jirto. Ma eegi kartaa?
choices.feedbackSo: Waa edeb leh, balse sheeg waxa aad rabto.

a.saySo: Galab wanaagsan. Sideen kuu caawin karaa?

b1.speaker: Assistant
b1.say: I am sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?

choices.text: Yes, here it is. It's dated the ninth.
choices.textSo: Haa, waa kan. Taariikhdu waa sagaalka.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa jawaab hufan.

choices.text: I've lost it, but I paid by card. Could you check the transaction?
choices.textSo: Waan lumiyey, balse kaadh ayaan ku bixiyey. Ma hubin kartaa macaamilka lacag-bixinta?
choices.feedbackSo: Waa hab wanaagsan oo xal loo raadiyo.

choices.text: No. Why do you need it?
choices.textSo: Maya. Maxaad ugu baahan tahay?
choices.feedbackSo: Waxay u muuqataa difaac; xaaladdaada sharax.

b1.saySo: Waan ka xumahay arrintaas. Rasiidka ma haysataa?

b2.speaker: Assistant
b2.say: I understand you are upset. Could you tell me what exactly is wrong?

choices.text: I'm sorry. The screen went black after a week and won't turn on.
choices.textSo: Waan ka xumahay. Shaashaddu toddobaad ka dib ayay madoobaatay, mana shidmayso.
choices.feedbackSo: Si edeb leh ayuu hadalka u hagaajiyey.

choices.text: Just give me my money back.
choices.textSo: Kaliya lacagta ii celi.
choices.feedbackSo: Dalab aan faahfaahin lahayn badanaa waxba ma fududeeyo.

b2.saySo: Waan fahmay inaad xanaaqsan tahay. Ma ii sheegi kartaa waxa saxda ah ee khaldan?

b3.speaker: Assistant
b3.say: Of course. What seems to be the problem?

choices.text: The screen has stopped working, so I would like a refund or a replacement.
choices.textSo: Shaashaddu way shaqayn weyday, sidaas darteed waxaan rabaa lacag-celin ama telefoon beddel ah.
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu bixiyaa laba xal oo suuragal ah.

choices.text: It doesn't work.
choices.textSo: Ma shaqaynayo.
choices.feedbackSo: Faahfaahin ku dar.

c1.speaker: Assistant
c1.say: Thank you. I can offer a full refund or a replacement. Which would you prefer?

choices.text: A replacement, please, if you have one in stock.
choices.textSo: Telefoon kale ayaan doorbidayaa, fadlan, haddii aad kayd ku haysaan.
choices.feedbackSo: Doorbid cad oo shuruud leh.

choices.text: I'd prefer a refund, thank you.
choices.textSo: Waxaan doorbidayaa in lacagta la ii celiyo, mahadsanid.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa cad yahay oo edeb leh.

choices.text: Whatever.
choices.textSo: Wax kasta.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa jawaab aan danayn muujinayn.

c1.saySo: Waad mahadsan tahay. Waxaan kuu soo celin karaa lacagta oo dhan ama telefoon kale ayaan ku siin karaa. Kee baad doorbidaysaa?

c2.speaker: Assistant
c2.say: Without a receipt I would need a manager to approve it. It may take ten minutes.

choices.text: That's fine, I'll wait. Thank you for your help.
choices.textSo: Waa hagaag, waan sugayaa. Waad ku mahadsan tahay caawimadaada.
choices.feedbackSo: Samir iyo edeb ayay muujinaysaa.

choices.text: This is ridiculous. I have no time.
choices.textSo: Tani waa wax aan macquul ahayn. Waqti ma hayo.
choices.feedbackSo: Xanaaqdu dhif ayay wax dedejisaa.

choices.text: Could you call me when the manager has decided? I can leave my number.
choices.textSo: Ma i soo wici kartaa marka maamuluhu go’aan gaadho? Lambarkayga waan ka tagi karaa.
choices.feedbackSo: Waa xal kale oo wax ku ool ah.

c2.saySo: Rasiid la’aantiis waa inaan maamule oggolaansho ka helaa. Waxay qaadan kartaa toban daqiiqo.

end.speaker: Assistant
end.say: Thank you for your patience. Is there anything else I can do for you?
end.saySo: Waad ku mahadsan tahay samirkaaga. Wax kale ma kuu qaban karaa?

contextSo: Waxaad telefoon iibsatay laba toddobaad ka hor, shaashaddiisuna way ciladaysan tahay. Waxaad joogtaa dukaankii.

title: Sharing a flat: a disagreement
context: Your flatmate keeps leaving dirty dishes in the sink. You want to talk about it.

a.speaker: Flatmate

choices.text: Yes. I'd like to talk about the dishes. Is now a good time?
choices.textSo: Haa. Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan ka hadalno weelasha. Hadda ma kuu habboon tahay?
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu tixgelinayaa waqtiga qofka kale.

choices.text: You never clean up!
choices.textSo: Waligaa ma nadiifisid!
choices.feedbackSo: Erayga “waligaa” wuxuu u ekaan karaa weerar.

choices.text: Nothing, forget it.
choices.feedback: Avoiding the issue will not solve it.
choices.textSo: Waxba, iska illow.
choices.feedbackSo: Ka meeraysiga dhibaatadu ma xallinayo.

a.saySo: Haye, ma waxaad rabtay inaad ila hadasho?

choices.text: There are often dirty dishes in the sink, and it's becoming a problem for me.
choices.textSo: Weel wasakh ah ayaa badanaa saxanka yaalla, arrintaasina way i dhibaysaa.
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu xaaladda ku sharxayaa dareenkiisa isaga oo aan qofka weerarin.

choices.text: You're so lazy.
choices.textSo: Aad baad u caajis badan tahay.
choices.feedbackSo: Aflagaaddada qofka waxay ku keentaa inuu is difaaco.

b2.speaker: Flatmate
b2.say: That's not fair. I've been very busy lately.

choices.text: I understand you're busy. Could we agree on a simple rota?
choices.feedback: Acknowledges the other view, then proposes a solution.
choices.textSo: Waan fahmay inaad mashquulsan tahay. Ma ku heshiin karnaa jadwal fudud oo hawsha loo qaybsado?
choices.feedbackSo: Wuxuu tixgeliyey aragtida kale, dabadeedna xal ayuu soo jeediyey.

choices.text: I don't care. Clean them now.
choices.textSo: Waxba igama gelin. Hadda dhaq!
choices.feedbackSo: Amaradu khilaaf ayay abuuraan.

b2.saySo: Taasi cadaalad ma aha. Muddooyinkan aad baan u mashquulsanaa.

b3.speaker: Flatmate
b3.say: Are you sure? You seem annoyed.

choices.text: Well, actually, yes. It's about the dishes.
choices.textSo: Hagaag, run ahaantii haa. Arrintu waxay ku saabsan tahay weelasha.
choices.feedbackSo: Daacadnimadu way ka wanaagsan tahay.

choices.text: I'm fine.
choices.textSo: Waan fiicanahay.
choices.feedbackSo: Dhibaatadu sidii hore ayay ahaanaysaa.

b3.saySo: Ma hubtaa? Waxaad u muuqataa qof xanaaqsan.

c.speaker: Flatmate
c.say: OK, you're right. What do you suggest?

choices.text: How about we each wash our own dishes the same evening?
choices.textSo: Ka warran haddii qof walba weelkiisa dhaqo isla fiidkaas?
choices.feedbackSo: Waa soo-jeedin cad oo cadaalad ah.

choices.text: You do all of them from now on.
choices.feedback: Not very fair; aim for compromise.
choices.textSo: Hadda ka dib adigu dhammaantood dhaq.
choices.feedbackSo: Cadaalad ma aha; isku day tanaasul.

c.saySo: Hagaag, waad saxan tahay. Maxaad soo jeedinaysaa?

end.speaker: Flatmate
end.say: Alright. Let's try that and see how it goes.
end.saySo: Waa hagaag. Aan sidaas isku dayno oo eegno sida ay noqoto.

contextSo: Qofka kula deggan guriga ayaa weel wasakh ah marar badan saxanka kaga taga. Waxaad rabtaa inaad kala hadasho.
